The following events took place in '''580 BBY'''.

==Events==
*[[Bodo Baas]] and a diplomatic delegation visit [[Yanibar]] in an unsuccessful attempt to convince the [[Zeison Sha]] to ally with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
*Baas and the delegation meet with [[Mendor Typhoons]] of the [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] above [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]], attempting to convince the Matukai of an alliance. They are again unsuccessful.
